description: The card offer skills pulled YNAB spend with inline curl against api.youneedabudget.com plus a token read from config/.env, instead of using the configured YNAB MCP connector (ynab-mcp-server, configured in Claude Desktop). YNAB is a connector and should be used like MCP.
correction: Use the YNAB MCP tools (get_accounts, get_transactions_by_account, get_transactions, get_categories, get_plan_months) for all YNAB spend reads. Inline curl is a fallback only if the MCP is unavailable.
root_cause: Skills were written before the YNAB MCP existed and never migrated.
